name: discord-message-sender
author: okawak
description: Send messages to Obsidian from Discord.

scripts.dev:build: bun run wasm:build && bunx vite build --mode development
scripts.build: bun run wasm:build && bunx vite build --mode production && bun run copy:manifest
scripts.clean:files: bun -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; ['dist','dev','pkg','main.js','main.js.map',...await Array.fromAsync(new Bun.Glob('*.wasm').scan('.'))].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, {recursive:true, force:true}))"
scripts.check: bunx biome check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked && cargo clippy --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib --locked
scripts.test: bun run test:ts && bun run test:rust
